lifecycle.prepare: Resolve one online Windows peer, scan one Ed25519 host key, and compare its SHA256 fingerprint without writing live state

lifecycle.doctor: Require exact managed bytes, strict effective SSH settings, the same independently pinned host fingerprint, and a key-only smoke
lifecycle.rollback: Remove only exact managed bytes and preserve all SSH keys and unrelated state
